original_question: Write a Verilog module named `shift_reg` with inputs `clk`, `en`, `din` and an 8-bit output `dout`. Implement a synchronous 8-bit left shift register. The register should shift its contents one position to the left on the positive edge of the `clk` signal, but only when the `en` signal is high. When shifting, the value of the `din` input should be loaded into the least significant bit (bit 0) of the register. The output `dout` should continuously reflect the current value of the internal register. The internal register should be initialized to all zeros.
